name: Do I need a water shut-off valve for my refrigerator water line?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a water shut-off valve for my refrigerator water line?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a dedicated water shut-off valve for your refrigerator water line is highly recommended and often a requirement. This valve allows you to quickly and easily turn off the water supply to your refrigerator for maintenance, repairs, or if a leak occurs, without affecting the water supply to the rest of your home. If your current setup lacks one, CG Plumbing Solutions will install a new shut-off valve to provide this essential control and safety feature.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a dedicated shut-off valve is highly recommended and often required. It allows you to turn off water to the refrigerator for maintenance or leaks without affecting the rest of your home.
